newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures finish lower in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures finish lower in quiet trading.

text.p: Sept 10 - U.S. debt futures finished lower in quiet trading after languishing most of the session. Euros finish midrange after short-covering developed late. Support in Dec Euros at 93.80, in March at 93.64. Traders await inflation data later this week. Redbook reported up 0.1 percent. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
